link-other.rationale: Explicit other project, affirmative other work.

link-same.rationale: Same contract explicitly denies asserted scope.

partial.rationale: Required leaflets not established; no denial.

denied.rationale: Same project explicit denial overrides partial support.

no-link.rationale: Bare unlinked denial, no affirmative other work.

other-work.rationale: Affirmative other work without same-project linkage.
